Full Depth Reclamation — Stabilization of in-situ (existing pavement crust) or soil or otherwise sub base/ base course up to the required depth by cold in-situ recycling using chemical additives/ otherwise: Providing pulverizing, spreading, milling and mixing of chemical additives at the appropriate rate as per job mix design in accordance with IRC: SP: 72-2015 and IRC-37-2018. Cementitious additive@ rate of minimum 4- 7% should be spread on the existing pavement using a mobile truck mounted containerized cement/ additive spreader with micro processor-controlled weighing and spreading system. The additive spreader shall have variable working width sufficient to cover whole pavement lane. The in-situ stabilization process shall be carried out by a mobile and self propelled stabilizer/ reclaimer of working width of 2.4m with minimum engine horse power of 440 kw with a variable working depth up to 50 cm. the resultant stabilized mix then would be profiled to the required grade, level and thickness using motor grader and the mix would be compacted using 20 tone pad foot roller in combination with smooth wheel roller to achieve desired proctor density as per IRC 37-2018 and complete in all respect and curing with water as required including all materials, labour and machinery etc. the entire in-situ process would be carried out in single pass with milling and pulverizing of damaged asphalt pavement/ soil/aggregates/ soil-aggregate mixture to the desired depth and with simultaneous addition of additives and water with machine integrated spray bars fitted on the wheeled self-propelled and vibratory pad foot roller to achieve therequired density.

Safety frame rail from metal sheet of 3.2 mm thick are fixed to main posts. shock absorbing rollers 345 mm diameter and 480 mm height made of polypropylene- EVA, post caps, locker, pipes and connection material. Distance between main post to short post shall be 500 mm c/c, the height of upper edge rail is 960 m m above road surface. All steel parts/frame shall be S235JR or equivalent SS400, the post shall be S235JR hot dipped galvanized. The system shall be installed as per drawing & specification enclosed, complete with 5 years free replacement warranty on all the material/ parts against any manufacturing defects and deformation but excluding damages due to accidents, if any. Note 1: This item shall be included in the DPR and executed only with prior written permission from the E-in-C MPPWD:

Bamboo Crash Barrier (Providing and erecting a 4 bamboo beam crash barrier comprising of bamboo poles having dia 80mm (±10mm), wall thickness of 10 mm, 0.85 m above road/ground level, fixed on clubbing of 3 bamboo vertical post, spaced 1.6 m post to post, 1.8 m high, 0.95 m below ground/road level, all steel parts and fitments to be galvanised by hot dip process, all fittings to conform to 4.8 grade steel, clubbing of 4 bamboo beam rail to be fixed on the vertical post with a spacer of dia 110 mm (+ 10mm), 300 mm long. All bamboo poles are well Seasoned, Treated with Creosote Oil through Vacuum Pressure Impregnation (VPI) method and High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) coated with coating thickness of Imm. End portion of approach side MELT Arrangement (Modified eccentric Loader Terminal) and End portion of departure side TT Arrangement (Trailing Terminal) as shown in figure 9.12 & 9.13 of the IRC SP-73- 2018 respectively. Including Yellow or White reflective strip to be affixed front face of heam and post. ( 25 ^ * 50 mm on Beam 500mm c/c, 50*50mm on post).

Providing and Laying of 15mm high Single Rib Pattern Transverse Bar Markings with 2 component cold plastic with specialised cold plastic Primer coating rolled on surfacing material solvent free, high build two pack seamless, tough, skid resistant, for material to reduce speed. Cold Plastic road marking material shall be applied in single monolithic application to create rumble strip ratsed section of 15 mm high, 300 mm wide confirming to clause 3.7 of IRC 99, across the entire carriageway. Each rumble marking shall be made complete with specialised high refractive index glass beads of minimum reflectivity index of 1.5. The glass bead shall be 250gm/sqm. Type 1 beads (Rofer MoRT&H Specification Clause803.4.2) which are a constituent of the basic cold plastic compound vide Table 800-9 ( MoRT&H Specification) and Type 2 beads are those which are to be sprayed on the surface vide Clause 803.6.4 ( MoRT&H Specification), Pavement Marking Performance such as Day/Night visibility, Dry/Wet visibility and skid resistance shall be confirming to clause 15.5 of IRC 35. The finished surface to be levelled, uniform and free from streaks and holes, to be applied on the edge lines including surface cleaning and cost of all materials stc. Complete.

Providing and fixing of Rumble Strip made up of TPU polyurethane (PU) Material size 500L x 100W x 15H mm and fixing of Rumble Strip in Bituminous grout/ Epoxy and Screwing the same with M.S Screw 15 x100mm etc. i/c removing asphalt at the site, Material, labour for fixing grouting and for controlling traffic during fixing etc. complete.

Providing and fixing Aluminum-backed flexible prismatic sheeting consisting of yellow colored flexible prismatic sheeting with non-metallic prismatic lens as retro reflective elements and conforming to ASTM D 4956-09 Type VI specification values for reboundable sheeting. AFP sheeting shall be of 1ft width with a 50 micron thick Aluminum (Al) foil with pressure sensitive adhesive and liner. AFP sheeting shall have screen printed arrow/slant line pattern in black color on top & shall not crack when tested for flexibility as per section S2.2.2 of ASTM D 4956-09. The AFP sheeting shall be applied with a neoprene contact adhesive with Polychloroprene as base & the edges of the product shall be sealed all around with a two-part epoxy based structural adhesive and shall be extremely resistant to peel-off & shall confirm to IRC 79-2019. The AFP shall be provided with govt test report from ARAI/ CRRI/ ICAT and report confirming to coefficient of retro reflection, Flexibility and impact resistance test as per ASTM which shall be submitted to engineer-in-charge before installation/ award of work.

Providing and fixing advance warning speed arrester stud made out of poly carbonate/ABS molded body and highly reflective panels with micro prismatic lens capable of providing total internal reflection of the light entering the lens face with retro reflectance and chromaticity values shall be as given in the detailed specifications and the product shall conform to minimum ASTM D4280 and also meet all the testing conditions of ASTM D4280 listed for RPM (Raised Pavement Marker). The testing and test report shall be as per IRC 35 clause 5.1.2. The speed arrester should be fixed to the road surface using the adhesive recommended by the manufacturer. The length, height and width of the body shall not be less than 150 mm, 9 mm and 90 mm with a tolerance of +/-1 mm. The marker shall support a load of 30000 Kg tested in accordance with ASTM D4280. The area of each side of micro prismatic reflective lensshall not be less than 15.0 sq.cm. The slope or retro – reflective surface shall be 25 + 2 degree to base. It should have one Shank of not less than 25 mm diameter and not less than 40 mm length molded with the body for anchorage. The certificate confirming to initial CIL value for reflective lens not less than 125 for red lens, 250 for yellow lens & 400 for white lens at 0° entrance and 0.2° observation angle as per ASTM D4280 shall be provided for better visibility & improving road safety for commuters.

Providing and fixing speed attenuators designed with a thick shell made of HDPE/ polyethylene. Filled with water absorbs light front impacts, and filled with sand absorbs bigger front impacts. Mainly suggested for installation in junctions, detours, streets, avenues, and highways as a crash cushion. The outer body of the attenuator is both UV resistant and weather resistant and pasted with retro- reflective sheeting of Grade Type IV and above. It includes a safety and filling valve with hermetic sealing that prevents water loss by evaporation. It's capable of carrying a ballast of water or sand. It doesn't have sharp corners and metallic parts in case of impacts or collisions. It should be either Orange or yellow in Colour for visibility during the daytime and it must have two arrow-shaped strip of retro-reflective sheeting Type IV or above to increase its visibility in night

Resilient Road Delineators Supply and installation of resilient road delineators (roadway indicators) made from highly flexible and durable EVA material. The delineators have a total height of 820mm and a diameter of 100mm. Each delineator should be equipped with three reflective sheets spaced evenly, meeting the retroreflectivity requirements according to ASTM D 4956 Tyupe XI label specifications. The delineator will feature grooves along its length to protect the reflective sheets from vandalism. After digging a 100mm hole, the delineator should be fixed with an anchor and screw, then grouted as per the Engineer's instructions.

Recharge tank inner side of diameter 1.5 metre including excavation upto 2.50 m depth and placing perforated NP4 1500 mm dia. pipe 3.00 m length, above 0.5 m ground level 150 mm diameter bore will be drilled up to 15.00 meter the ground water table or the sand layer, whichever is higher. Inside the percolation tank, a recharge zone will be prepared with multiple filtration layers to enhance groundwater recharge which shall be consist of 1. Brick Bats Layer: Positioned above the gravel layer to aid filtration 0.5 m height. 4. Coarse Sand Layer: (1.5 mm to 2 mm in size) 0.50 m height forming the topmost layer for improved filtration efficiency. Cable and suspension Superstructure. The work includes the supply, fabrication, installation, monitoring, and multi-stage stressing/prestressing of stay cables using a parallel strand system with 15.2 mm diameter strands and a guaranteed ultimate tensile strength (GUTS) of 1860 MPa. The stay cables shall be cut and placed in the specified profiles to provide permanent deck support. The scope also includes: - Installation of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) sheathing ducts. - Fixing live anchorages at the deck and dead anchorages at the pylon, with steel anchor boxes embedded in the pylon as per approved drawings. - Completion of all works in accordance with detailed drawings and technical specifications. - Recess filling with approved materials and application of protective coating and wax after tensioning. - Recording and reporting of tensioning data. - Proper treatment of the projected strand ends after anchoring and covering them with specified materials. - Health monitoring using a magnetic flux system with online operation and maintenance for 10 years. - Testing of materials, including fatigue testing, to ensure compliance with specification

Structural Steel Work for Bridge Superstructure. Providing and installing structural steel work for the superstructure of bridges, including Bow String, Composite Girder, Semi-Through Girder, and Plate Girder types. The work involves cutting, riveting, bolting, or welding, as well as launching with the necessary lifting arrangements, in accordance with the approved design. It also includes hoisting into position and completing all associated tasks. Metallizing of steel girders shall be carried out by spraying aluminum after surface preparation through sand/grit blasting. This process will be followed by: - One coat of etch primer (IS: 5666) - One coat of zinc chrome primer (IS: 104) - Two coats of aluminum paint (IS: 2339) All work shall include labour, tools, plants (T&P), and materials, ensuring compliance with relevant specifications and procedures as per Clause 39 of IRS-B1-2001. Coating Specifications: - Nominal thickness of sprayed aluminum coating: 150 microns - Dry film thickness (DFT) of zinc chrome primer: 25-30 microns - DFT of each coat of aluminum paint: 12-14 microns The structural steel shall conform to Grade Designation E250, with Quality B0 as per IS: 2062, in accordance with Section 1900 of the specifications. Note: The rate for the deck slab shall be as per RCC/PSC T-Beam and slab specifications. — Bow string

The supply of apparatus is included one extra a ground glass plate as mentioned above, training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability.

Providing Pile Integrity Tester based on the reflected wave method and fit for testing drilled piles and hammer piles, for low strain non-destructive integrity testing of concrete pile (diameter up to 1.5 m) and identify the extant and location of the pile defect as per IS 14893:2021. It must also be useful for testing exposed top surface of construction such as pillars. The supply of apparatus is included wireless sensors, Laptop/Notepad with appropriate software up to lifetime use, Hammer stocked with interchangeable tips and all other necessary accessories, training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability.

Providing portable and battery-operated Wall Scanner, based on Radar Technology, to detect objects like magnetic metals (e.g. iron), non-magnetic metals (e.g. copper), live cables, low-voltage & data cables (Three-phase power cables, cavities), non-live cables, wooden substructures, water-filled plastic pipes, Empty plastic pipes etc up to 200 mm deep with Object view, Spot view, Signal View, Signal View 2D, in wall or dry concrete. The equipment must be able to transfer data by USB-C, SD-Card or wirelessly for analysis and documentation. The supply of equipment is included (a) Necessary software, if needed, with life time validity. (b) Training to the laboratory staff at site, and (c) Calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability, if needed.

Providing portable and battery-operated Dowel, Transvers, and reinforcement bar (diameter up to 50 mm) locator, based on Radar Technology, to measure the position and diameter of Dowel, transverse, and reinforcement bar, up to 240 mm depth in concrete. The equipment must be able to transfer data by USB-C, SD-Card or wirelessly for analysis and documentation. The supply of equipment is included (a) Necessary software, if needed, with life time validity. (b) Training to the laboratory staff at site, and (c) Calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability, if needed.

Providing Digital Concrete Rebound Hammer of following specifications, to measure the compressive strength of concrete by measuring the rebound index after striking the concrete surface. (b) Training to the laboratory staff at site, and (c) Calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability, if needed.

Providing Cylindrical Core Cutter to cut the core from fine-grained natural or compacted soils, made of steel, complete as per IS: 2720 (part 29) including providing training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability.

Providing 150 mm diameter size Crushing Value Test Apparatus to determine crushing strength of aggregate, made of steel, complete with cylindrical cell, plunger, base plate, tamping rod, metal measure etc, as per IS: 2386 (part 4) including providing training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability.

Providing Cylindrical Metal Measures of 3, 15 and 30 litres capacity with temping rods to determine bulk density and voids of aggregate, made of steel, complete as per IS: 2386 (part 3) including providing training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability.

Providing and fixing electrically operated Centrifuge Extractor as per IS: 19008:2023 to determine the binder percentage of bituminous materials, including installation, providing training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability. Providing Ring and Ball Apparatus as per IS:1205 to determine the Softening Point of bitumen, including installation, providing training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability. Providing and fixing electrically operated Ductility Testing Machine with 3 moulds and base plates as per IS:1208 to determine the Ductility of bitumen, including installation, providing training to the laboratory staff at site and calibration by NABL accredited calibration lab with traceability. meta: MP PWD Schedule of Rates for Road & Bridge Works, in force from 11.04.2025. Rate analyses: MoRTH Standard Data Book for Analysis of Rates, 2nd Revision 2019, Vol. I (plain/rolling terrain), matched to SOR items by description; small-project quantities; overheads 12 % + profit 10 % (roads), 20 % + 10 % (bridges), 30 % + 10 % (rehabilitation); leads: mixing plant to site 10 km, borrow area 1 km. Basic rates at the SOR 2025 price level: labour and machinery back-calculated from the SOR rates (labour = MP labour rate x 0.66, machinery = SDB 2019 usage rate x 0.45), materials from SOR 2025 note 5.3, chapter 1 and the MP basic list. Items whose analysis does not explain the printed rate within -25 %/+33 % carry the SOR rate only.
